fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: This rule detects the execution of Run Once task as configured in the registry
fields.name: Run Once Task Execution as Configured in Registry
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains "\\runonce.exe" or tgt.process.displayName="Run Once Wrapper") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "/AlternateShellStartup" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/r")))
